title: Mixed Event — Beside Unchanging Warmth — Episode7 Anything I Can Do

meta.Event Outline: One day in December, Mizuki's sister sends word from abroad that she'll be coming to visit, to Mizuki's delight. Warm memories resurface, of a time long ago when the two of them went shopping together. And so, Mizuki extends an invitation to go once again.

rows.Line: A few hours later
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We bought so much stuff!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not only did I get my hands on everything I wanted, I got to put together outfits with you, Sis! I couldn't have had a better time!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I had a lot of fun too!
I got to go around to a lot of shops, get a feel for what's trending in Shibuya right now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: And I got to meet your friends, Mizuki♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Picking out presents with Shiho and Saki was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I hope we get to take more time the next time we do this. I might try inviting them myself since there's a few shops I really wanna show them♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? About what?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
There's something I didn't mention...
The truth is, Mizuki, I came back because I've been wanting to see your smiling face.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Remember when I sent you that outfit I made and you sent me a bunch of photos in return?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: You looked like you were having so much fun in them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, I did send her a bunch so she'd know that things have been fun lately.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Pictures from that picnic, from that cheer performance during the sports festival...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Ones where I'm really smiling...
The old me could've never imagined days like that would come.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: What you sent back made me want to come home and see you in person...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Which is why I couldn't be happier about you having so much fun today!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sis... Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, how have things been with your group? You mentioned them to me a while back, and they were in a lot of the pictures too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
We're still making music together!
We've even been hanging out, throwing after-parties...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I totally forgot! We threw a countdown party together for New Year's and...!
Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, what are the odds...?!
I was just talking about you two!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Huh? Does this mean they're...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! This is Kanade and Mafuyu! We're in the same group!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, um... I'm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's okay, Mafuyu, you can relax.
This is my big sister! It's okay to just be yourself!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... My name is Kanade Yoisaki. I'm the composer for our group...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My name is Mafuyu Asahina. It's nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Nice to meet the both of you!
I'm Yuki Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: This is so wonderful. I've been hoping to meet you since Mizuki's told me so much about your group!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see.
Mizuki's mentioned you a few times, so it's nice to finally meet you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, Kanade, what are you two doing here? You're not here for the big sales, right...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, we came to buy groceries and other daily necessities.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The supermarket by my house would've done just fine, but walking a little further seemed like a nice way to get some exercise and take our mind off things...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, why not go out somewhere to get a breath of fresh air? After all, staying cooped up inside isn't exactly good for your health...!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <For our health... Yes, it's been hard to get myself to go outside since it's been so cold, but a walk might not be a bad idea.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Is Kanade doing this for Mafuyu?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(It is New Year's...
I don't want her to dwell on things either.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Is there anything I can do to help?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Some way to make things even a little easier for Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, my accessory's a scrunchie...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This purple color feels kinda grown-up, but the frills are so adorable!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I bet it'd look great on Mafuyu...!
I should ask her to try it on sometime!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That reminds me. I got something good from one of the sales today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Something good...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup! Ta-daa!
I bet this scrunchie would look great on you, Mafuyu! What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I see what you mean.
This color does have a mature feel to it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I think you should try it on, Mafuyu.
The impression you give off may change a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So, it's all yours if you want it...?
It's not all that frilly or anything, so you should be able to wear it on a regular basis!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But...
Didn't you get this for yourself?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, it came from a lucky bag!
I thought it'd look great on you the second I saw it, Mafuyu! That's why I really wanna see you with it on!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Plus, it's cute and fashionable...
It could help change the way you feel a little.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, but you don't have to take it if you don't want it!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll take it...
Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, let's see how you look with it on♪
Ooh, want me to do your hair?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That won't be necessary.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?! Why?!
Pretty please!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I'm so happy for you, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Kanade, Mafuyu...
I hope you and Mizuki keep getting to have fun like this!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... Yes, I hope so as well...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Sis, you're embarrassing me!
And Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Huh? I just thought I needed to say that as your big sister!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, you really didn't...
